description.narrative: The project is implemented in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The main outcome area it contributes to is equality and workers' rights. The main right holders are trade union members in the public sector. Through members-driven development of labour legislation, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between the Trade Union of Administration in Republika Srpska (SURS) and The Palme Center. SURS organises employees in the public sector in Bosnia and Herzegovina's semi-autonomous entity Republika Srpska.Project ObjectiveThe project objective is that workers in Republika Srpska actively participate in social processes of direct interest for them, with the support of a trade union that has influence on social dialogue.Actor groups---Decision makers--- Governments at entity and national level Social and Economic Council: Local administration units Public bodies and institutes ---Actors in Cooperation--- NGOs Media ---Rights-holder--- Trade union members Formal workers Women and youth
